speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Medullary Sponge Kidney.

The urinalysis confirms microscopic hematuria with sterile pyuria (positive leukocyte esterase, negative nitrites), and the imaging reveals the pathognomonic finding of multiple cysts in the collecting ducts of the medulla without obstruction. This constellation of recurrent UTIs, hematuria, and specific medullary cysts confirms this diagnosis.
